hadiths.ar: لَمَّا قَضَى اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ كَتَبَ فِي كِتَابِهِ إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي غَلَبَتْ غَضَبِي
hadiths.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah: When Allah decreed the Creation He pledged Himself by writing in His book: My mercy prevails over My wrath.

hadiths.ar: كَذَّبَنِي ابْنُ آدَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ
hadiths.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah: Allah said: The son of Adam denied Me and he had no right to do so.

hadiths.ar: أَصْبَحَ مِنْ عِبَادِي مُؤْمِنٌ بِي وَكَافِرٌ
hadiths.en: Narrated Zayd ibn Khalid: This morning one of My servants became a believer in Me and one a disbeliever.
